pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment was carried out by heating sludge samples (50 ml) in reactors at temperatures ranging from 110 °C to 150 °C for 20 min in an oil bath (Daihan Science, Korea).
Alkaline pretreatment was conducted by adding 5 N solutions of Ca(OH)_2, KOH, and NaOH to 50 ml of WAS to attain a final pH ranging from 8 to 13, mixing for 1 h (individual) or 20 min (combined).
Ultrasonication was performed with 50 ml of WAS using a 20 kHz frequency (VCX-750, S&M, USA) and 20% amplitude (Max.750 W).

Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) involved forcing fluid flow through a venturi tube or orifice plate (1 mm diameter, 27 holes) with pressures of 0.7 and 0.07 MPa to generate cavitation bubbles for sludge disintegration.
